promotionalText.value: Version 1.1 adds five topics - exchange rates, consumer spending, taxes, fiscal policy and economic indicators - for 120 sourced cards in all.

description.value:
Finally understand the news about the economy - inflation, interest rates, tariffs, recessions - in a five-minute daily set.

EconByte turns economics into short cards you actually finish. The front of each card explains one concept in plain language. Flip it over for a real-world example, with the institution and document it came from. Build a streak, save the cards you want to keep, and read everything offline.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- 120 cards across 15 topics, eight cards per topic
- Inflation and Interest Rates are free, with no account and no sign-up
- GDP, Supply & Demand, Labor Markets, Trade & Tariffs, Housing Market, Central Banks, Recessions, Debt & Deficits, Exchange Rates, Consumer Spending, Taxes, Fiscal Policy and Economic Indicators open with one $0.99 purchase

HOW IT WORKS
- Start today's set: eight cards, about five minutes
- Tap a card to flip from the concept to the sourced example
- Bookmark anything you want to come back to
- Optional daily reminder, off until you turn it on

SOURCED, NOT GUESSED
Every factual claim is traceable to a named institutional source - the Bureau of Labor Statistics, the Federal Reserve, the Congressional Budget Office and their peers - with the document and date shown on the back of the card. Claims that could not be reproduced from a primary source were removed rather than estimated.

EDUCATION ONLY
EconByte explains how the economy works. It does not provide financial, investment or tax advice, and it makes no claims about returns or performance.

PURCHASES AND ADS
Two separate one-time purchases: Unlock All Topics ($0.99) opens the other 13 topics, and Remove Ads ($0.99) removes the ads. Neither is a subscription, and neither includes the other. Without Remove Ads, a short ad can appear only when you finish a set and return to the home screen - never while you are reading a card.

ACCESSIBILITY
Cards can be flipped with VoiceOver and announce their topic, position, face and source. Reduce Motion replaces the card rotation with a cross-fade.
description.changeFrom1_0: rewritten: 1.0's description described 10 topics and an every-5-cards ad. Both are false in 1.1.

whatsNew.value:
Version 1.1 - a bigger, re-sourced curriculum and quieter defaults.

NEW CONTENT
- 120 cards across 15 topics, eight per topic
- Five new topics: Exchange Rates, Consumer Spending, Taxes, Fiscal Policy and Economic Indicators
- Every card was re-verified against a named institutional source, with the document and date on the back
- Inflation and Interest Rates stay free, and the other 13 topics are covered by the existing Unlock All Topics purchase at no extra charge

REMINDERS AND CHOICES
- Optional daily learning reminder, off until you turn it on
- Usage analytics and crash diagnostics are separate opt-in choices, both off by default

ADS
- Ads now appear only at a natural break, when you finish a set and return to the home screen, never while you are reading
- Remove Ads remains a separate one-time purchase

ACCESSIBILITY
- Cards can be flipped with VoiceOver and announce topic, position, face and source
- Reduce Motion replaces the card rotation with a cross-fade

reviewNotes.value:
EconByte: Daily Economics is an educational card app. It explains economics concepts - inflation, interest rates, GDP, trade, taxes, fiscal policy - in short daily sets. IT IS NOT FINANCIAL ADVICE: every card carries an on-screen educational-use disclaimer, and the app makes no investment, tax or performance claims.

WHAT IS NEW IN 1.1
120 cards across 15 topics (was 80 across 10). Inflation and Interest Rates remain free; the other 13 topics are covered by the existing Unlock All Topics purchase.

FREE REVIEWER PATH (no purchase needed)
1. Launch the app. Tap Start on TODAY'S CARDS.
2. Tap a card to flip it; the back shows a real-world example with its named source.
3. Tap Next through the set to reach the completion screen.
4. On Home, tap Bookmarks to see saved cards. Under BROWSE TOPICS, Inflation and Interest Rates are fully playable without any purchase.

IN-APP PURCHASES (two independent one-time non-consumables, both already approved)
- com.nsantulli.econbyte.unlockall, $0.99 - unlocks the 13 paid topics. Path: Home > BROWSE TOPICS > tap any locked topic (for example GDP) > Purchases screen > 'Unlock All - $0.99'. Also reachable at Home > gear > Settings > Purchases > Unlock All Topics.
- com.nsantulli.econbyte.removeads, $0.99 - removes ads. Path: Home > gear > Settings > Purchases > Remove Ads.
- Restore Purchases is on both the Purchases screen and Settings > Purchases.
- The two products are deliberately independent: Remove Ads does not unlock topics, and Unlock All Topics does not remove ads. Settings states this in the section footer.
- To exercise purchases without a sandbox account, open EconByte.xcodeproj and run the EconByte scheme: the scheme is wired to the committed StoreKit test configuration EconByte.storekit, which declares both product identifiers and prices.

ADVERTISING
Interstitial ads are contextual and non-personalized only. The app does not request App Tracking Transparency authorization and does not use the advertising identifier; every ad request is sent with npa=1 and rdp=1 and a G maximum ad content rating. An ad can appear at exactly one place: after a set is completed, when returning to the home screen. It is capped at one per app session and two per calendar day, at least 15 minutes and two completed sets apart, and never appears while a card, paywall, purchase sheet, permission prompt or rating request is on screen. Ads are not served at all to devices set to an EEA country or the United Kingdom.

NOTIFICATIONS
Off by default. The iOS permission dialog appears only after an explicit opt-in: either Settings > Notifications > Daily Learning Reminder, or the 'Turn On Reminders' button that can appear on a session-complete screen. The reminder is a single local notification at 7:00 p.m.; there is no push server and no token.

PRIVACY CHOICES
Usage analytics and crash diagnostics are separate opt-in toggles in Settings, both off by default, offered once after the first completed set. No analytics or crash provider is configured in this build, so nothing is transmitted either way.

OTHER
No accounts, no user-generated content, no third-party login. iPhone only, portrait only. All content ships in the binary and works offline.
